blocks.text: Have you ever written a letter to a friend or a teacher? Letters are a great way to communicate and express our thoughts.

blocks.markdown: In this lesson, we will explore the two main types of letters: informal and formal. Informal letters are usually written to friends and family, while formal letters are used for official communication.

blocks.title: What is an Informal Letter?
blocks.text: An informal letter is a personal letter written to someone you know well, such as a friend or family member. It uses a casual tone and may include personal anecdotes.

blocks.markdown: When writing an informal letter, it is important to include the address, date, and greeting. The address is usually placed at the top right corner, followed by the date. The greeting can be casual, such as 'Dear John'.

blocks.title: Writing an Informal Letter
blocks.prompt: Write an informal letter to your friend inviting them to your birthday party.

steps.text: Start with your address at the top right corner.
Next, write the date below your address.
Begin the letter with a greeting, such as 'Dear [Friend's Name]'.
In the body, invite your friend and provide details about the party.
End with a closing, such as 'Yours sincerely'.

blocks.answer:
123 Main Street
Lagos, Nigeria

October 1, 2023

Dear Chika,

I am excited to invite you to my birthday party on October 15th at my house. There will be games, food, and lots of fun!

Yours sincerely,

Tunde

blocks.markdown: Now, let's look at formal letters. A formal letter is written for professional or official purposes. It has a specific structure and uses a formal tone.

blocks.title: Features of a Formal Letter
blocks.text: A formal letter typically includes the sender's address, the date, the recipient's address, a formal greeting, the body of the letter, and a closing. It is important to maintain a respectful tone throughout.

blocks.markdown: The main difference between informal and formal letters is the tone and purpose. Informal letters are personal and casual, while formal letters are serious and structured.

blocks.title: Key Points to Remember
blocks.text: Always check the structure of your letter before submitting it. Make sure to include all necessary components, especially in formal letters.

points: Informal letters are personal and written to friends or family.
Formal letters are structured and used for official communication.
